notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Full Path/Update Notes:

> Additional early-game potions.
> Potion-Man has 12 potions distributed between 50 kills.
> Minor volume tweaks to balance headphone experience.
> Some Dialogue box text-warp fixes and typo corrections.
> [Ultimate Tomes] can now be sold from inventory (error).
> Fixed incorrect tile color when fishing.

[[[Bosses]]]
> Curse Paint: 
-40 HP, (from 540 to 500)
Gains 25 HP instead of 30 in-between fights.

> Frostotem: 
-8 Defense, (from 38 to 30).
> Arachno-Jack:
-15 Defense in non-candle form,
+ 5 Defense in candle form,
decreased odds of candle going out from 3~6 turns to 3~5.
Gains 16 Speed instead of 10 in-between fights.

> Mimic-King:
-400 HP, (from 3800 to 3400)
Gains +200 HP instead of 180 in-between fights.
